title: phacelia pringlei var. orogenes
intro: Phacelia pringlei var. orogenes, commonly known as a variant of the Phacelia pringlei plant, is a type of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to support respiratory health, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the respiratory system. The therapeutic actions of Phacelia pringlei var. orogenes include acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and as an anti-inflammatory, reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
